UNSUPPORTED.en: This Agent Server does not support business agents yet. Upgrade the server to use this page.
UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 当前 Agent Server 尚不支持业务智能体。请升级服务端后使用此页面。

WELCOME.en: Choose an agent, describe your goal, and follow its progress.
WELCOME.zh-CN: 选择智能体，描述目标，并查看执行进度。

NO_AGENTS.en: No agents are available yet. Install and enable a business package below to get started.
NO_AGENTS.zh-CN: 暂无可用智能体。请在下方安装并启用业务包。

TASK_LABEL.en: What would you like to accomplish?

TASK_PLACEHOLDER.en: Describe your goal, useful context, and the result you need.
TASK_PLACEHOLDER.zh-CN: 描述目标、相关背景以及你希望获得的结果。

NO_BACKEND.en: Connect an Agent Server to get started.
NO_BACKEND.zh-CN: 连接 Agent Server 后即可开始。

REQUEST_FAILED.en: The request could not be completed.

NO_CONVERSATION.en: The task was created but has no conversation yet. Try again with the same task to reconnect.
NO_CONVERSATION.zh-CN: 任务已创建，但尚无会话。请重试同一任务以重新连接。

PACKAGES_DESCRIPTION.en: Install a package to add its agents, tools, and skills. Enable it when you are ready to use it.
PACKAGES_DESCRIPTION.zh-CN: 安装业务包以添加智能体、工具和技能，准备好后启用即可使用。

SOURCE_LABEL.en: Package directory on the Agent Server
SOURCE_LABEL.zh-CN: Agent Server 上的业务包目录

UNINSTALL_CONFIRM.en: Uninstall {{name}}? Its agents will no longer be available for new tasks.
UNINSTALL_CONFIRM.zh-CN: 卸载 {{name}}？之后新任务将无法使用其中的智能体。

NO_ARTIFACTS.en: Files shared with this task and its results will appear here.
NO_ARTIFACTS.zh-CN: 本任务的附件和成果将显示在这里。

CALL_RESOLUTION.zh-CN: 核实执行结果不确定的工具操作

CALL_RESOLUTION_HELP.en: Check the external system before recording whether this action happened. This decision does not restart the task.
CALL_RESOLUTION_HELP.zh-CN: 请先核查外部系统，再记录此操作是否已经执行。记录决定不会自动继续任务。

CALL_RECORDED.en: Decision recorded. Resume the task separately when you are ready.
CALL_RECORDED.zh-CN: 决定已记录。准备就绪后，请单独选择继续任务。
